relevant_prelims_pyqs.question_text: Consider the following pairs: [2025] Provision in the Constitution of India : Stated under I. Separation of Judiciary from the Executive in the public services of the State : The Directive Principles of State Policy II. Valuing and preserving of the rich heritage of our composite culture : The Fundamental Duties III. Prohibition of employment of children below the age of 14 years in factories : The Fundamental Rights How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?

relevant_prelims_pyqs.markdown_formatted:
**Q1 (2025)**: Consider the following pairs: [2025] Provision in the Constitution of India : Stated under I. Separation of Judiciary from the Executive in the public services of the State : The Directive Principles of State Policy II. Valuing and preserving of the rich heritage of our composite culture : The Fundamental Duties III. Prohibition of employment of children below the age of 14 years in factories : The Fundamental Rights How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?

- (b) Only two
- (c) All the three
- (d) None
- **Answer**: `(c)` ([View Source Page 59](pages/prelims/prelims_page_059.pdf))
